sections.heading: 1. Three desk resets
lines: ② Drop them, lengthen your neck, 3 slow breaths.
③ Shrug up hard, hold 2 sec, then let go fully.
④ Rows and shrugs twice a week build capacity.

sections.heading: 2. See a GP or physio first if…

caption:
Three meetings in a row, and Mr Turtle's shoulders are up around his ears. He says it feels like carrying bricks.

Your upper traps run from the base of the skull to the shoulders. After long desk days and stress, that tight feeling often means muscles tired from working for hours, not muscles that are too short.

Hybi's reset: roll back five times, drop and breathe three times, shrug hard and let go. Rows and shrugs twice a week can help too. Remedial massage can ease tenderness and works well alongside these habits.

Arm tingling or weakness, severe headaches or chest pain need a GP or physio first. Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio are here to help. Book online via the link in bio.
